name: OwnTech_Examples
description: A library that contains OwnTech Power API examples

examples.name: Open Loop PWM
examples.title: Open Loop PWM
examples.description: Simple open loop PWM example

examples.name: Twist Measurements Enable
examples.title: Twist Measurements Enable
examples.description: Initializes the Twist power shield in Buck mode and enables the default measurements without ever starting the PWM, so there is no power flow. Just reads and prints leg currents/voltages and the high side current/voltage over serial.

examples.name: Voltage Mode Buck
examples.title: Voltage Mode Buck
examples.description: Voltage mode buck converter using PID controller for TWIST

examples.name: Voltage Mode Boost
examples.title: Voltage Mode Boost
examples.description: Voltage mode boost converter using PID controller for TWIST

examples.name: Current Mode Buck
examples.title: Current Mode Buck
examples.description: Peak current mode buck converter using PID controller for TWIST

examples.name: Interleaved
examples.title: Interleaved
examples.description: Interleaved mode buck converter with PID controlled output voltage

examples.name: Independent
examples.title: Independent
examples.description: Independent mode buck converter with each leg controlled by a dedicated PID

examples.name: Simple scope example
examples.title: Simple scope example
examples.description: Simple example of triggering the scope to acquire a step response.

examples.name: Current Ripple Measurement
examples.title: Current Ripple Measurement
examples.description: Current ripple measurement in buck voltage mode, by sweeping adc trigger

examples.name: Grid Following Inverter
examples.title: Grid Following Inverter
examples.description: It is an AC current source which follow a grid voltage. Commonly, a grid-following inverter adjusts its output to match the voltage and frequency of the existing electrical grid

examples.name: Grid Forming Inverter
examples.title: Grid Forming Inverter
examples.description: It generates an AC voltage source. Commonly, a grid-forming inverter is a device that autonomously establishes and maintains stable grid voltage and frequency.

examples.name: Open-Loop Sine Inverter
examples.title: Open-Loop Sine Inverter
examples.description: Single-phase H-bridge driven with a local 50 Hz sine without any voltage or current feedback. Baseline for checking PWM generation and duty clamping before moving to closed-loop inverter examples.

examples.name: Grid-Forming Inverter
examples.title: Grid-Forming Inverter
examples.description: Single-phase voltage-control inverter using singlePhaseInverter in FORMING mode with a local teaching sine. Generates its own voltage reference without requiring external grid synchronization.

examples.name: Grid-Following Inverter
examples.title: Grid-Following Inverter
examples.description: Single-phase current-control inverter using singlePhaseInverter in FOLLOWING mode. Uses a PLL to synchronize with the grid or a local teaching sine before enabling regulated current injection.

examples.name: CAN Communication
examples.title: CAN Communication
examples.description: This example deploys CAN communication of the Twist board

examples.name: Python Communication Protocol
examples.title: Python Communication Protocol
examples.description: This example allows a user to control a Twist in DC-DC buck mode using a Python script.

examples.name: RS485 Communication
examples.title: RS485 Communication
examples.description: This example deploys a simple RS485 communication interface.

examples.name: ThingSet Serial Communication
examples.title: ThingSet Serial Communication
examples.description: Exposes data over the Zephyr shell using the ThingSet protocol on a dedicated USB-CDC serial port, separate from the console.

examples.name: OwnVerter Open-Loop Manual Duty
examples.title: OwnVerter Open-Loop Manual Duty
examples.description: Beginner OwnVerter example: initializes the power stage, enters and leaves power mode from the serial console, and changes a PWM duty cycle manually.

examples.name: OwnVerter Measurements Enable
examples.title: OwnVerter Measurements Enable
examples.description: Initializes the OwnVerter power shield in Buck mode and enables the default measurements without ever starting the PWM, so there is no power flow. Reads and prints the three leg currents/voltages, the high side current/voltage, and the three leg temperatures over serial.

examples.name: OwnVerter Sine Modulation With ot_sin
examples.title: OwnVerter Sine Modulation With ot_sin
examples.description: Beginner OwnVerter example that replaces the fixed duty cycle with a sinusoidal modulation law built with ot_sin, converting a modulation index into three-phase duty cycles.

examples.name: Three-Phase Grid-Following Inverter
examples.title: Three-Phase Grid-Following Inverter
examples.description: Three-phase grid-following inverter control strategy using a PLL to synchronize with the grid and regulate current injection.

examples.name: Three-Phase Grid-Forming Inverter
examples.title: Three-Phase Grid-Forming Inverter
examples.description: Three-phase grid-forming inverter control strategy that generates its own voltage reference and regulates the output voltage without requiring external grid synchronization.
